Prima & Timo — Album 7: Quattuor

Of Cores It Matter

"Billions left behind in the dark"

[Hidden realm ambience + soft creature sounds] [Verse 1] Deeper into the realm, forgotten creatures came to view All ages gathered here, in a world hidden from the blue Preema spoke to many, heart heavy with what she learned When an Age ends, they’re brought here… never to return

Sofia approached, six legs, tall and lizard-faced She could fly, she could swim, with ancient knowledge in her grace “Weehards were our name, caretakers of Age 12 long past Forgotten by history… our stories never last” [Pre-Chorus] Sofia froze mid-sentence, sleepy sickness taking hold Then woke again, continuing her story, brave and bold [Chorus — emotional] Of Cores it Matters Billions left behind in the dark Of Cores it Matters Forgotten, discarded, torn apart Machines without cores, creatures without home All waiting here… never to be known [Verse 2] The team listened closely, hearts aching with the truth Machines on the ground, never awakened in their youth “Because they were sent here before their cores were placed” Sofia explained softly, sorrow in her face

Preema felt the weight, the injustice running deep Billions of cores, discarded, left to sleep She looked at her team, voice steady and true “We won’t let this happen… we’ll change it, me and you” [Pre-Chorus 2] They spent the day talking, learning names and lore Promising to return… and open up the door [Chorus — emotional] Of Cores it Matters Billions left behind in the dark Of Cores it Matters Forgotten, discarded, torn apart Machines without cores, creatures without home All waiting here… never to be known [Bridge — determined] Stoney rumbled softly, “We’ll find my family too” Bernard hopped, “WE HELP EVERYONE, NINJA CREW!” Vendo dispensed gifts, quiet but full of heart The team stood united… ready to play their part [Solo] [Coda] We now know our knowledge is limited and never the full view Why did they force the hand off to happen sooner for me and you The same cycle repeating again now for a billion years Like a force hidden is hiding something that it fears

Let’s break the cycle - [key lift][note lift] [Chorus — emotional] Of Cores it Matters Billions left behind in the dark Of Cores it Matters Forgotten, discarded, torn apart Machines without cores, creatures without home All waiting here… never to be known [Chorus — emotional] Of Cores it Matters We will not let this happen again Of Cores it Matters This cycle must be stopped, must be broken Machines without cores, creatures without home We will return soon we promise we will not forget [Outro — hopeful resolve] The forgotten watched them go…

A spark of hope in their eyes

We will see you again soon

Be safe, Miss Preema and Crew

We will be here, waiting for you

Thank you.
